title: Relay Reserve
designBriefSource: The requested six-family planning batch; private prompt retained outside distribution.
goal: Reach the free eastern doorway cell (15,5,0).
stageDependency: Prepare M1 -> approach with M0 -> travel around with M1 -> regain the left face of retained M0 -> cross the final gate lane and leave above it.
planningBurden: The second shield must be placed before committing to the first approach; the first shield must remain useful during a long handoff.
changedConstraints: Two reciprocal handoffs replace the source one-way release.
A narrow spawn connector prevents freely swapping away the preparation obligation.
The final exit requires returning to the initial courier from a new side.
physicalScope: One 16 by 16 room; ordinary pinned official engine; all initial actors at elevation zero.

difficulty.qualification: An author estimate from dependent operations and planning tradeoffs, not calibrated human difficulty.

limits: The listed handoff events and the M0 -> M1 -> M0 reuse are necessary under exhausted exclusions.
No claim that every movement between handoffs or every turning cell is uniquely required.
